toolsPreview.name: advanced_search_availability
toolsPreview.description: [DETAIL TOOL] Search appointment slots/cards. Use directly when clinic is known, or after search_available_clinics_map selection. Params: city (required), medical_service, doctor, clinic, start_day/end_day (YYYY-MM-DD). Date rules: 'tomorrow/domani' is the day after today; 'next week/prossima settimana' means the next calendar Monday-Sunday week, not tomorrow. If no results with doctor/clinic filters, automatically retries without them. Returns slots with booking_url for checkout (supports pre-filled params: &name=&last_name=&email=&phone=&tax_code=).

toolsPreview.name: search_available_clinics_map
toolsPreview.description: [MAP TOOL] Discover clinics with availability and render them on map/sidebar. Params: city (required) + one of medical_service/doctor/clinic, optional date/time range. Date rules: 'tomorrow/domani' is the day after today; 'next week/prossima settimana' means the next calendar Monday-Sunday week, not tomorrow. Then wait for user click in widget; after selection run advanced_search_availability with city + medical_service + selected clinic.

toolsPreview.name: search_suggest_city
toolsPreview.description: Find cities by partial name. Use when: User mentions unfamiliar city or you need coordinates. Returns: City names, coordinates, province, region. Follow: Use city name with advanced_search_availability.

toolsPreview.name: smart_suggest_service
toolsPreview.description: Smart service finder (text search + AI combined). Use when: User has vague symptoms/descriptions OR you need to explore service options before booking. Runs parallel search and AI prediction, merges results by relevance. Returns: Service names and IDs. Follow: Use service info with advanced_search_availability.
